name: CSO_PIPELINE_ITEM_STATUS
description: This table contains Status for each of the Items in the Pipeline that require it.  Data in here will be short-lived as it is processed and removed by the Pipeline Service.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Unique Primary Key for this table.

columns.name: PIPELINE_ITEM_ID
columns.description: ID of the Pipeline Item to which this Status belongs.

columns.name: PROCESSED_COUNT
columns.description: Number of items processed for this parent item.

columns.name: FAILED_COUNT
columns.description: Number of items that failed to process for this parent item.

columns.name: TOTAL_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of items to be processed for this parent item.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
